cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 shows a service checking people against the ID system: the 2025 rule makes operators link each SIM to an NNI, and ANATS began verifying a mobile operator's customer data only under a May 2026 partnership.
cells.note: ANATS and Airtel signed in May 2026 to interconnect their systems and verify subscribers (TCD-001), so stage 2. ARCEP's 2025 statement that SIMs must be linked to an NNI (TCD-002) is a rule, often unmet, not a check against the system, so not 3.
